name: Wizard
description: A scholar of arcane formulae who shapes magic through study.
skill_choices: Choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, and Religion.
starting_equipment: A spellbook, a quarterstaff, and a scholar's pack.
multiclassing: You need Intelligence 13 to multiclass into or out of this class.

features.title: Spellcasting
features.description: You maintain a spellbook and prepare spells from it.

features.title: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day, you recover a portion of your magical energy after a short rest.

subclasses.name: Star Sage
subclasses.introduction: Star Sages read omens in the movement of distant lights.

features.title: Astral Reading
features.description: You can consult a star chart to sharpen one divination each day.
